messages:
alisa: FYI changed package `exports` in @redwood/js-sdk to add conditional node/edge fields. After publishing, edge sample app import starts failing in Cloudflare worker runtime and TS types complain.

devon: ugh, what's the error? repro?

alisa: From sample-app: `import { createClient } from '@redwood/js-sdk'` -> runtime: `Uncaught ReferenceError: process is not defined` in worker. TS: "Module '@redwood/js-sdk' has no exported member 'createClient'".

chris: run `node --trace-warnings` or show package.json exports plz

maria: here's the exports we pushed:

```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "node": "./dist/node/index.js",
    "default": "./dist/edge/index.mjs"
  },
  "./*": "./dist/*"
}
```

maria: Edge build picks `default` but bundler turns it into a CJS require in sample which expects process

ben: Also seeing auth retry behavior weirdness with that build — token refresh hits fallback route and fails fast.

alisa: repro steps I used:
1) clone sample-app
2) yarn
3) `wrangler dev` -> see `ReferenceError: process is not defined`

devon: could be that our edge bundle still imports `node:crypto` somewhere. search for `process` or `node:` imports.

chris: found in `dist/edge/index.mjs` we still use `process.env.REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG` in a guard. Should remove and use globalThis or build-time replace.

maria: TS types: our `types` field points to `dist/index.d.ts` which only exports CJS entry, so `default` entry doesn't have proper typings for named exports -> TS can't resolve `createClient`.

ben: immediate fix: rollback exports change or publish patch where `exports` includes an explicit `import` condition for `types` and `worker`.

alisa: temporary workaround for sample-app: change import to `const sdk = await import('@redwood/js-sdk/dist/edge/index.mjs')` and use `sdk.createClient` — ugly.

devon: for long term: propose we add an `edge` condition and update bundler tests (cloudflare/deno/fastly). Also add a CI job that runs `wrangler dev` smoke test on sample-app.

maria: +1. Also add linting rule to ban `process` usage in edge entrypoints, and add a types test (tsc) against sample-app in CI

deploy-bot: deploy requested by maria for patch-exports -> staging

ben: after patch deploy i still saw auth retry 502s in dedicated env — raising a related ticket.

alisa: cool — I'll draft a PR to update exports to:

```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "worker": "./dist/edge/index.mjs",
    "import": "./dist/node/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/node/index.cjs"
  },
  "./types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
}
```

chris: looks good, include a note about avoiding `process` and add `globalThis` polyfill in tests.

devon: thanks all — assigning followups: maria (types CI), chris (edge guard cleanup), ben (auth retry ticket), alisa (PR + sample fix)

alisa: will update thread with PR link

maria: thx
